name: jurnii-lemlist-zoho
description: Daily one-directional import of Lemlist LinkedIn outbound activity into Zoho CRM as completed Tasks.
//: CommonJS on purpose, and this manifest is LOAD-BEARING. The repo root declares "type": "module", so without it Node would treat every .js here as ESM and `module.exports` would break. server.js and worker-runner.js are ESM and load this subsystem via createRequire(); booking/ is CommonJS too and is required across for the Zoho client, auth and logging. Do not remove: see api/package.json, which exists for the same reason.
